description.en: Flaked fish and malunggay in coconut milk.

text.en: The city’s recipe uses shredded stingray, malunggay and coconut milk.
The fish is simmered with vinegar and ginger.
The guide identifies shredded smoked fish as an alternative when stingray is unavailable.

sources.title: Naga City Tourism: Bicolano Lenten recipes
